experiment: Nested threshold tuning and feature selection
threshold_policy: Graph if predicted graph-minus-vector utility exceeds the threshold. Threshold selected using inner out-of-fold training predictions only. Primary objective is training OOF Recall@5; ties prefer more Graph selections.
feature_selection: SelectKBest with f_regression fitted only on each training partition.
routing_constraint: Every adaptive variant executes exactly one retrieval family per question. No RRF or fallback.
